title: ImageMeta
description: Sidecar file for every image under content/images/ and every site illustration under src/assets/illustrations/ (license original-illustration only). The validator refuses images without it and licenses outside the allowlist.

attribution_text.description: Exact credit line shown on the site

permission_evidence.description: Reference to the written permission kept in the owner's private archive (date, sender initials, archive id). Never a file in this public repository. Required for permission-granted.

shows_logo.description: True when the device bears a brand mark; the mark must not be extracted or used elsewhere
